| description = This giant is the son of Beleveios Thunderstone, a Kromrif leader from the Eastern Wastes. Beleveios was irritated by the "crimes" of [[Vorken Iceshard]] and his brother Klaggan and arranged an assassination of the two. They descended upon the Iceshard brothers, intent to slit their throats as they slept. However, before the deed could be done, Klaggan awoke, snapping the neck of one of the assailants, the brothers quickly leaping to their feet and grabbing their axes. After a short fight the brothers stood victorious, coated in blood as a dumbfounded Beleveious stared at them. Beleveious fell to his knees, begging for mercy and forgiveness, prattling on about his family and wanting to protect his people. Vorken would hear none of it, and beheaded him. Vorken was disgusted that Beleveious didn't bother for an honorable trial by combat, and now he is hearing rumors of "an assassination by this fool who wants vengeance for a father who would murder men in their sleep.". That's where you come in!

Located in an isolated spot near the northwest corner. Other frost giants will attack him. You may use this to your advantage to damage him but take care that no NPC lands the finishing blow on him.

<s>High MR, resists something like 7/10 snares, but definitely soloable in low 50s with some effort.</s> Resisted zero spells at lv60 and I threw the kitchen sink at him. Possible that the previous report was just unlucky...

20 minute respawn time.
